uncited: **Inputs:** Unstructured mesh data containing cells of type linear or quadratic tetrahedra, bricks, prisms, wedges, or pyramids; scalar or vector field data associated with vertices; camera parameters; and lighting model parameters.
The system relies on a visibility ordering algorithm to determine the front-to-back or back-to-front traversal of cells.
**Visibility Ordering:** Compute the exact visibility order of all cells relative to the viewpoint.
**Projection:** Project the 3D cells onto the 2D image plane.
For tetrahedra, this is done with high accuracy.
**Compositing:** Composite the projected and shaded cells according to the visibility order.
*   **Accuracy Mode:** High accuracy is enforced for linear and quadratic tetrahedra.
*   **Subpixel Threshold:** Not given in the sources.
*   **Time Complexity:** The system is computationally intensive.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
*   **Strengths:** Very high accuracy; exact mathematical solutions for integrals and interpolation; handles complex unstructured meshes (non-convex, disconnected, mixed types).
*   **Limitations:** Not intended for interactive purposes; slow performance even on high-end hardware; approximations are introduced for mixed cell types (not high accuracy).
*   **When to Use:** Batch-mode rendering where image quality is paramount and performance is secondary.
*   **When Not to Use:** Interactive applications or real-time rendering.
